PART III - LANDS Title Registration NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS

Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 (Section 12) NOTICE No. 52/1193 Colombo District IT is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the owner ship or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands reflected in the Cadastral Map No. 521606 made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 relating to the village of Pagoda (Block 08) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No.519 Nugegoda in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Sri Jayawardanapura Kotte in the District of Colombo in the Province of Western Province should submit his claim to the undersigned before 29th of August 2024 In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned date, action will be taken to hold an exparte inquiry to determine title to the land and accordingly publish such determination in the Government Gazette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act. The Cadastral Map No. 521606 referred to above may be perused at the relevant Grama Niladhari Office, Divisional Secretariat, District Survey Office, Office of the Commissioner of Title Settlement, or the Surveyor - General’s office. Further information may be obtained from the Grama Niladhari, the Divisional Secretary, or the Commissioner of Title Settlement. P. C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No.1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 29th of July 2024.
(Published by Authority)

Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 (Section 12) NOTICE No. 81/0354 Galle District IT is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the owner ship or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands reflected in the Cadastral Map No. 810488 made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 relating to the village of Banwelgodalla (Block 01) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No.66C - Banwelgodalla in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Gonapeenuwala in the District of Galle in the Province of Southern should submit his claim to the undersigned before 29th of August 2024 In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned date, action will be taken to hold an exparte inquiry to determine title to the land and accordingly publish such determination in the Government Gazette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act. The Cadastral Map No. 810488 referred to above may be perused at the relevant Grama Niladhari Office, Divisional Secretariat, District Survey Office, Office of the Commissioner of Title Settlement, or the Surveyor - General’s office. Further information may be obtained from the Grama Niladhari, the Divisional Secretary, or the Commissioner of Title Settlement. P. C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement.
